sampler: Optional-IDM; 9 video frames; 32x7 actions; 10 video + 10 action steps; sigma_shift=1; CPU RNG; compile=false; original observation frame0 clamp
primary_metric: test case-paired fixed BF16 reader first10motor_rmse vs same-input same-seed BF16 action; average seeds then22cases. Also native action, future NMSE, full32,late22,gripper; all arms and cases retained.
claim_scope: Frozen-cohort internal capacity-removal diagnostic from action-only epoch2. No codeword/indices refit, no new training or episodes; sparse representation bytes are accounting, execution decoded BF16/fake A4; no native speed or novel/generalization proof.
score_definition: At frozen full action-only checkpoint, per-calibration-case accumulated decoded-weight adjoints. Removal delta is exact BF16 base-minus-full. Signed directional loss increase for future NMSE and fixed-BF16-reader first10 motor MSE; empirical Fisher squares only after accumulating all calls. Joint Fisher uses g_action + frozen_lambda*g_latent before squaring. Proposed future_reader_damage averages positive normalized latent_damage and reader_damage.
budget_definition: One fixed two-bit tag per4096-vector tile:0=no residual,1=even vector slots,2=all slots. Uniform has tag1 everywhere; ranked arms full on floor(T/2) tiles, half on next if odd, none elsewhere. Every arm reserves2048*T uint8 residual index slots including tail padding, all base indices, both codebooks, BF16 row scales, same transforms and metadata. Full reference is outside the matched sparse budget and reused.
pre_scoring_amendment: Before any GPU score/data collection: add activation-diagonal local-output reconstruction control and action-only signed directional damage control, so any advantage is not confounded by activation weighting or first-order versus squared scoring.14 total arms; cohort, budget, primary metric unchanged.
post_score_allocation_controls: Planned before inspecting calibration rankings: three controls match future_reader_damage full/half/zero tag counts separately in every Linear, then choose positions by random/reconstruction/jointFisher.
